content: {"episode_id":"ep-05027","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for episode ep-05027. The clinical indication documents a patient with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. We request reconsideration of the precertification denial on the basis of this documented medical necessity."}
